label: Customer Relationship
definition: Measures of the customer base and how customers feel about the group: new customers, customers with orders, churn and retention, satisfaction scores, Net Promoter Score and experience ratings.
scope_note: Who the customers are and how satisfied they are. How actively they use the website and app belongs to Engagement.

label: Engagement
definition: Measures of how actively customers and users interact with the online shop, the app and campaigns: website traffic, visits, sessions and active users.
scope_note: Customer and user activity. Employee engagement belongs to Workforce.

label: Balance Sheet
definition: Measures of what the group owns and owes at a point in time: assets, liabilities, equity, investments, inventory value, accounts payable and receivable, invoices due, and liquidity ratios.
scope_note: Stocks of value at a point in time, not flows over a period. Taxes owed belong to Tax.

label: Cost
definition: Measures of money spent: operating expenses, facility running costs, marketing and advertising spend and budgets, shipping and freight costs, cost of goods sold and capital expenditure.
scope_note: Amounts of money spent or budgeted. Ratios of output to input belong to Efficiency; amounts owed belong to Balance Sheet.

label: Revenue
definition: Measures of money earned from selling goods and services and of the sales behind it: revenue, sales, turnover, orders and order value, interest income, and the profit or net income left after costs.
scope_note: Includes profit and net income, and order counts as a measure of sales volume. Spend and expense amounts belong to Cost.

label: Risk
definition: Measures of financial risk and losses in the banking and insurance arms: loan defaults, credit losses and insurance claims settled.
scope_note: Financial risk only. Food-safety incidents belong to Quality.

label: Tax
definition: Measures of taxes owed or paid to tax authorities, such as income, payroll and sales taxes.

label: Efficiency
definition: Measures of how well resources are turned into output: operational efficiency ratios, resource utilization and productivity per hour or per unit of input.
scope_note: Ratios of output to input. Plain amounts of money spent belong to Cost.

label: Quality
definition: Measures of product and process quality and safety: food-safety incidents, defects and compliance with quality standards.
scope_note: How well operations meet quality and safety standards. How customers rate their experience belongs to Customer Relationship.

label: Supply Chain
definition: Measures of how goods are bought, stocked, moved and delivered: inventory turnover, stock levels, freight, shipping and delivery.
scope_note: Use together with Cost for freight and shipping costs.

label: Workforce
definition: Measures of the group's employees: employee satisfaction, engagement and wellbeing, usually from staff surveys.
